Ui.Script:
-- The timer switch (ref uvar, UIOptionsFrame.lua l.21/104 — its `default = "0"`). This -- assignment is the ONLY statement of our default: the saved chunk executes over it at load -- (1128) and the Interface page's row captures it as its Defaults value at OnLoad, which -- runs first. "1" because the director asked for visible timers (0255) — the divergence is -- written down once, here, and Defaults honours it rather than the reference's table. SHOW_BUFF_DURATIONS = "1" RegisterForSave("SHOW_BUFF_DURATIONS")
-- The reference's flash cadence + thresholds (BuffFrame.lua l.1-14). An aura in its last 31s -- pulses between full and BUFF_MIN_ALPHA; its duration text turns highlight-white under 60s. BUFF_FLASH_TIME_ON = 0.75 BUFF_FLASH_TIME_OFF = 0.75 BUFF_MIN_ALPHA = 0.3 BUFF_WARNING_TIME = 31 BUFF_DURATION_WARNING_TIME = 60
-- The dispel-class border tints (BuffFrame.lua l.9-14); "none" is the undispellable red the -- debuff overlay wears by default. UnitDebuff's debuffType return keys this table. DebuffTypeColor = { ["none"] = { r = 0.80, g = 0.00, b = 0.00 }, ["Magic"] = { r = 0.20, g = 0.60, b = 1.00 }, ["Curse"] = { r = 0.60, g = 0.00, b = 1.00 }, ["Disease"] = { r = 0.60, g = 0.40, b = 0.00 }, ["Poison"] = { r = 0.00, g = 0.60, b = 0.00 }, }
-- SecondsToTimeAbbrev + its GlobalStrings (UIParent.lua l.1034 / GlobalStrings.lua). We load -- no UIParent/GlobalStrings, so define them here (guarded, in case a later file ships them). DAY_ONELETTER_ABBR = DAY_ONELETTER_ABBR or "%d d" HOUR_ONELETTER_ABBR = HOUR_ONELETTER_ABBR or "%d h" MINUTE_ONELETTER_ABBR = MINUTE_ONELETTER_ABBR or "%d m" SECOND_ONELETTER_ABBR = SECOND_ONELETTER_ABBR or "%d s"
if not SecondsToTimeAbbrev then function SecondsToTimeAbbrev(seconds) if seconds > 86400 then return format(DAY_ONELETTER_ABBR, ceil(seconds / 86400)) elseif seconds > 3600 then return format(HOUR_ONELETTER_ABBR, ceil(seconds / 3600)) elseif seconds > 60 then return format(MINUTE_ONELETTER_ABBR, ceil(seconds / 60)) end return format(SECOND_ONELETTER_ABBR, seconds) end end
-- The frame-wide flash pulse (BuffFrame_OnLoad / _OnUpdate, BuffFrame.lua l.17-56). One -- BUFF_ALPHA_VALUE is computed per frame and every low-on-time button reads it, so they blink -- in unison. The bar also seats each duration string under its button here. function BenillaBuffFrame_OnLoad(frame) BuffFrameFlashTime = 0 BuffFrameFlashState = 1 BUFF_ALPHA_VALUE = 1 for i = 0, 23 do getglobal("BuffButton" .. i .. "Duration"):SetPoint("TOP", "BuffButton" .. i, "BOTTOM", 0, 0) end BenillaBuffButtons_UpdatePositions() end
-- BuffButtons_UpdatePositions (BuffFrame.lua l.152-160): the ROW PITCH depends on whether a -- timer sits under each icon. Shown, the three rows land at y = 0/−45/−90 (a 30px icon + a -- 15px gutter); hidden, at 0/−35/−70 — the icons close up to the same 5px the columns use. -- The reference reaches those two geometries by re-anchoring through its TempEnchant chain, -- which we do not have; same two numbers, our own anchors, and SetPoint on a point already -- held overwrites it (layout.rs — the client's own SetPoint law). -- -- This is the Buff Durations row's `applyFunc`, and the ONLY thing the setting needs applied: -- the timer text itself is re-decided every frame by the poll below, so a click changes what -- the next frame draws without anyone telling it. Geometry is the part that is stated once. function BenillaBuffButtons_UpdatePositions() local gutter = -5 if SHOW_BUFF_DURATIONS == "1" then gutter = -15 end BuffButton8:SetPoint("TOP", "BuffButton0", "BOTTOM", 0, gutter) BuffButton16:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", "BuffButton8", "BOTTOMRIGHT", 0, gutter) end
function BenillaBuffFrame_OnUpdate(elapsed) BuffFrameFlashTime = BuffFrameFlashTime - elapsed if BuffFrameFlashTime < 0 then local overtime = -BuffFrameFlashTime if BuffFrameFlashState == 0 then BuffFrameFlashState = 1 BuffFrameFlashTime = BUFF_FLASH_TIME_ON else BuffFrameFlashState = 0 BuffFrameFlashTime = BUFF_FLASH_TIME_OFF end if overtime < BuffFrameFlashTime then BuffFrameFlashTime = BuffFrameFlashTime - overtime end end
if BuffFrameFlashState == 1 then BUFF_ALPHA_VALUE = (BUFF_FLASH_TIME_ON - BuffFrameFlashTime) / BUFF_FLASH_TIME_ON else BUFF_ALPHA_VALUE = BuffFrameFlashTime / BUFF_FLASH_TIME_ON end BUFF_ALPHA_VALUE = (BUFF_ALPHA_VALUE * (1 - BUFF_MIN_ALPHA)) + BUFF_MIN_ALPHA end
-- A button caches its filter (set in the template OnLoad), its per-filter id (the XML `id`, -- 1-based to match our UnitBuff/UnitDebuff index), takes right-clicks, and listens for the -- aura change. The first paint hides it until the feed reports an aura. function BenillaBuffButton_OnLoad(button) button:RegisterForClicks("RightButtonUp") button:RegisterEvent("UNIT_AURA") BenillaBuffButton_Update(button) end
function BenillaBuffButton_OnEvent(button) if arg1 == "player" then BenillaBuffButton_Update(button) end end
-- The button's aura: the Nth of its own filter, in the app's display order. The ONE lookup -- both handlers use — the ref's BuffButton_Update and BuffButton_OnUpdate likewise resolve -- the same buffIndex, one on the event and one per frame. function BenillaBuffButton_Aura(button) local id = button:GetID() if button.buffFilter == "HARMFUL" then return UnitDebuff("player", id) end return UnitBuff("player", id) end
-- Pull the button's aura and repaint the discrete parts: icon, stack count, debuff-border -- tint. Those are what the aura-change event exists for. The countdown is NOT cached here — -- see BenillaBuffButton_OnUpdate. No aura ⇒ hide the button (which hides its icon/border -- with it) and blank its duration string. -- BuffFrame_UpdateDuration (BuffFrame.lua l.247-259), gate and all: the timer draws only when -- the setting is on AND there is a live one. `timeLeft` nil covers both of the other cases — -- no aura in this slot, and a permanent aura (no duration on the wire). Hidden, not blanked: -- see the header's deviation note. function BenillaBuffButton_SetDuration(button, timeLeft) local durationText = getglobal(button:GetName() .. "Duration") if SHOW_BUFF_DURATIONS ~= "1" or not timeLeft then durationText:Hide() return end durationText:SetText(SecondsToTimeAbbrev(timeLeft)) if timeLeft < BUFF_DURATION_WARNING_TIME then durationText:SetVertexColor(HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.r, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.g, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.b) else durationText:SetVertexColor(NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.r, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.g, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.b) end durationText:Show() end
function BenillaBuffButton_Update(button) local name, icon, count, debuffType = BenillaBuffButton_Aura(button)
if not name then button:Hide() BenillaBuffButton_SetDuration(button, nil) return end button:SetAlpha(1.0) button:Show()
getglobal(button:GetName() .. "Icon"):SetTexture(icon or BENILLA_FALLBACK_ICON)
-- Debuff border, tinted by dispel class (harmful buttons only — helpful ones have no -- $parentBorder, so getglobal is nil and we skip it). local border = getglobal(button:GetName() .. "Border") if border then local color = DebuffTypeColor[debuffType] or DebuffTypeColor["none"] border:SetVertexColor(color.r, color.g, color.b) end
-- Stack count, shown only above 1 (BuffButton_Update l.95-102). local countText = getglobal(button:GetName() .. "Count") if count and count > 1 then countText:SetText(count) else countText:SetText("") end end
-- Per-frame: RE-READ the expiration (never a cached one), count it down against GetTime(), -- flash in the last 31s, and write the abbreviated timer (highlight-white under 60s). -- expirationTime == 0 is a permanent aura (no duration on the wire) — our "until -- cancelled": no timer, no flash. -- -- The re-read every frame is the reference's own shape, and it is load-bearing: ref -- BuffFrame.lua l.128-130 calls GetPlayerBuffTimeLeft(this.buffIndex) inside -- BuffButton_OnUpdate, caching only the INDEX on PLAYER_AURAS_CHANGED. A duration that -- changes without any discrete change — a recast, a DoT reapplied, cast pushback, the -- server's replay of every duration at world entry — fires no aura event, so a button that -- cached its expiry on the event would keep counting the OLD one down, sit at "0 s" while -- the buff is still live, and never show a timer for an aura whose duration landed after -- its icon did. Both were live defects; the poll is what makes them unrepresentable -- (decision 0846). function BenillaBuffButton_OnUpdate(button) local name, _, _, _, _, expirationTime = BenillaBuffButton_Aura(button) if not name or not expirationTime or expirationTime <= 0 then button:SetAlpha(1.0) BenillaBuffButton_SetDuration(button, nil) return end
local timeLeft = expirationTime - GetTime() if timeLeft < 0 then timeLeft = 0 end -- The flash is NOT gated on the setting: the reference pulses a button in its last 31s -- from BuffButton_OnUpdate, whether or not a timer is drawn under it (l.128-138), and -- with the timers off it is the only thing left saying "about to drop". if timeLeft < BUFF_WARNING_TIME then button:SetAlpha(BUFF_ALPHA_VALUE) else button:SetAlpha(1.0) end BenillaBuffButton_SetDuration(button, timeLeft) end
-- Right-click cancels (BuffButton_OnClick → CancelPlayerBuff). Resolve within the button's own -- filter so a debuff button's id can't reach into the buff list; the app sends CMSG_CANCEL_AURA -- for a cancelable buff and drops the rest. -- Hover: the aura tooltip through the engine channel (decision 0274 P2 — the verified -- aura variant: white AuraDescription + the SetPlayerBuff-only remaining line). The -- OnUpdate re-poll keeps the remaining line ticking while hovered. Anchor: the ref's -- BuffButton hangs the plate BELOW-left (ref BuffFrame.xml l.37 ANCHOR_BOTTOMLEFT — -- the buff row sits at the screen's top-right, so the tooltip drops under it). function BenillaBuffButton_OnEnter(button) if not GameTooltip then return end -- engine tests load file subsets GameTooltip:SetOwner(button, "ANCHOR_BOTTOMLEFT") GameTooltip:SetPlayerBuff(button:GetID(), button.buffFilter) end
function BenillaBuffButton_OnLeave(button) GameTooltip:Hide() end
function BenillaBuffButton_OnClick(button) CancelUnitBuff("player", button:GetID(), button.buffFilter) end
